request_body.raw_goal: Finish my MSc thesis proposal — defense is in 10 weeks.
request_body.user_context: Final-year part-time MSc Data Science student, also working full-time as a junior backend developer. Hard deadline, first time using this kind of tool, somewhat skeptical.

objectives: Synthesize existing literature to identify a specific, researchable problem in data science.
Define a formal methodology including data sources, feature engineering, and model architecture selection.
Construct a coherent written argument for the thesis proposal, justifying both the theoretical novelty and technical feasibility.
Prepare a formal defense presentation that anticipates technical scrutiny from the thesis committee.

proposed_milestones.description: Formulate the thesis research question and conduct a structured literature review.
objectives: Select and refine a core data science problem statement that meets MSc-level novelty requirements.
Perform a systematic literature search in repositories like arXiv, IEEE Xplore, or ACM Digital Library.
Synthesize gathered papers into a 'Related Work' section identifying a clear research gap.

proposed_milestones.description: Design the technical methodology and experimental framework.
objectives: Specify the datasets required and define the preprocessing pipeline for data normalization or cleaning.
Select appropriate baseline models and candidate architectures to be tested against the hypothesis.
Define metrics for evaluation that align with both standard statistical rigor and the research objective.

proposed_milestones.description: Draft the full thesis proposal document following institutional formatting requirements.
objectives: Compose the 'Problem Statement', 'Methodology', and 'Expected Outcomes' chapters.
Draft the 'Timeline and Feasibility' section to demonstrate the research is achievable within the remaining study duration.
Conduct a final pass to ensure academic tone and mathematical notation consistency.

proposed_milestones.description: Synthesize the proposal into a defense presentation and final review.
objectives: Create slide decks focusing on the 'Problem Statement' and 'Proposed Methodology' sections.
Anticipate and write out responses to potential committee questions regarding data bias, model performance, or hardware constraints.
Conduct a dry run of the presentation against the proposal text to ensure logical flow.

success_metrics: Approval of the finalized written proposal draft by the primary supervisor.
Completion of a presentation deck comprising all required thesis proposal sections.
Successful scheduling of the formal defense date with the department.

request_body.raw_goal: I want to prepare for a technical interview at a company I'm targeting. No fixed deadline yet, but I want it tracked alongside my thesis work.
request_body.user_context: Already has an active thesis-proposal goal in progress. Wants this as a second, lower-urgency concurrent goal.

objectives: Develop proficiency in algorithmic problem-solving patterns suitable for technical interviews.
Solidify conceptual understanding of core computer science fundamentals and system design principles.
Cultivate clear and concise verbal communication skills for technical problem explanation.
Simulate high-pressure interview conditions to refine timing and performance.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish a foundational problem-solving cadence by mapping out key data structures and algorithmic paradigms.
objectives: Create a study inventory of core data structures: arrays, hash tables, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and graphs.
Review common traversal techniques and Big O complexity analysis for time and space efficiency.
Select an integrated development environment and language-specific standard library for implementation practice.

proposed_milestones.description: Engage in systematic practice of pattern-based problem solving using competitive programming platforms.
objectives: Solve a curated set of problems targeting specific patterns: sliding window, two-pointer, fast/slow pointers, and merging intervals.
Implement solutions for dynamic programming and greedy algorithm challenges, focusing on state identification.
Document common edge cases and pitfall patterns discovered during implementation cycles.

proposed_milestones.description: Shift focus to system design principles and behavioral communication frameworks.
objectives: Study foundational architecture concepts including load balancing, caching, sharding, and database replication.
Draft and refine responses for common behavioral interview questions using the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) method.
Synthesize high-level system components to solve design prompts like URL shorteners or social media feed architectures.

proposed_milestones.description: Execute mock interview cycles to bridge the gap between theory and performance.
objectives: Conduct timed mock interviews to practice verbalizing thought processes while coding.
Refine technical explanations for system design trade-offs under constraints.
Analyze recorded or peer-reviewed sessions to identify and remediate communication gaps or coding inefficiencies.

success_metrics: Completion of 75+ categorized algorithmic challenges on a reputable coding platform with optimal time/space complexity.
Ability to complete a medium-difficulty coding problem within 30 minutes while vocalizing the entire thought process.
Successful articulation of two high-level system design architectures under a 45-minute time limit.
Consistent identification of time and space complexity for any implemented algorithm prior to submission.

request_body.raw_goal: Rebuild a regular gym routine — I've been sedentary for months.
request_body.user_context: Low impact, no deadline, identity-driven rather than outcome-driven. Already has interview-prep goal active; thesis goal is at or near its natural conclusion.

objectives: Re-establish a consistent baseline of physical activity through low-impact movement.
Develop a sustainable routine that integrates with current life responsibilities.
Transition from a sedentary state to active maintenance without injury or burnout.
Solidify the identity of a consistent gym-goer through repetitive habit formation.

proposed_milestones.description: Establish a base-level movement routine utilizing low-intensity, non-weight-bearing cardiovascular activity.
objectives: Incorporate 15 minutes of zone 1-2 cardiovascular exercise on stationary equipment such as a recumbent bike or elliptical.
Perform basic mobility and joint-prep movements to reintroduce range of motion to tight muscle groups.
Maintain a minimum frequency of two sessions per week to prime neural and physical adaptations.

proposed_milestones.description: Introduce progressive load resistance training using machine-based movements to ensure safe neuromuscular engagement.
objectives: Implement a full-body movement pattern sequence focusing on compound machine exercises like leg presses, chest presses, and seated rows.
Focus on execution of movement patterns and controlled tempo rather than increasing weight load.
Track RPE (Rate of Perceived Exertion) for each session to ensure intensity remains in the moderate, manageable range.

proposed_milestones.description: Formalize the routine and integrate volume and frequency adjustments to stabilize habit consistency.
objectives: Transition to a structured 3-day-a-week frequency to solidify gym attendance as a baseline habit.
Incorporate light free-weight stabilization exercises to complement the existing machine-based training.
Develop an automated post-workout recovery protocol including dedicated cool-down stretching.

success_metrics: Achieved 12 weeks of consistent gym attendance with at least 2 sessions per week.
Increased total weekly activity duration from 30 minutes to 90 minutes without experiencing musculoskeletal pain or DOMS-related drop-offs.
Completing a full-body resistance circuit with consistent form and controlled tempo for 3 consecutive weeks.
